ratings.rationale: Policy tampering can bias the time scale or relax checks, reaching displacement or deception. Cited sources are non-malicious timing outages, so they show path but not malicious mechanism.
ratings.issue: Sources are path evidence of failures, not malicious policy tampering.

ratings.rationale: Falsified ephemerides bias the solver geometry and can displace tracks. The cited GPS timing anomaly is not falsified orbit data and does not support the malicious mechanism.
ratings.issue: Cited GPS timing incident does not evidence falsified ephemerides.

ratings.rationale: Withheld or delayed orbit products can cause flagged denial or unflagged bias. The Galileo outage is non-malicious path evidence, not malicious withholding.
ratings.issue: Dual outcome blurs primary category; cited outage is path evidence only.

ratings.rationale: Key disclosure is a precondition enabler, not a target-report consequence. Cited ACARS and SATCOM terminal work is analogue attack evidence, so evidence is downgraded.
ratings.issue: Enabler; cited evidence comes from other systems.

ratings.rationale: Abused key management enables impersonation but has no direct report consequence. Cited journals appear survey-level and general-space, so evidence is weak and analogue.
ratings.issue: Enabler; overlaps T4.04/T4.12 and has weak attack evidence.

ratings.rationale: Configuration or firmware changes can relax integrity thresholds and reach displacement or deception. Viasat is strong analogue satellite-network incident evidence; Moonlighter supports management-network risk.
ratings.issue: Generic; overlaps T4.07/T4.15 and relies on analogue evidence.

ratings.rationale: Destructive management commands can wipe or disable payloads, causing regional denial. Viasat provides E3 analogue evidence of destructive update impact.
ratings.issue: Denial scope may be overbroad; Viasat is analogue.

ratings.rationale: Tampering downstream of every check can alter verdicts or the picture, reaching displacement or deception with no L3 detection. NATS failure is only non-malicious path evidence.
ratings.issue: Cited NATS failure is path evidence, not malicious tampering.

ratings.rationale: Stopping or degrading the ATM feed causes regional loss of surveillance. Detection occurs at L4 when ATM notices loss; source is only path evidence.
ratings.issue: Cited NATS failure is path evidence, not malicious disruption.

ratings.rationale: Altering the controller interface bypasses all upstream checks and can deceive controllers. No source is cited, and scope is one working position affecting several aircraft.
ratings.issue: No cited support; overlaps T4.08 but at controller working position.

ratings.rationale: Disclosure of orbit and coverage data only enables geometry-targeted later attacks. Asset binding is partly wrong: precise ephemerides sit in A4.2, not only the ATM feed.

Broad insider misuse spans thresholds, ephemerides, keys and configuration, so it is an umbrella duplicate of specific records. Cited Hack-A-Sat and E-enabled aircraft sources are analogue and not direct.
Supplier compromise is a precondition enabler for later malicious updates or commands. Cited journals are survey-level general-space evidence, so confidence and evidence are limited.
Absence of per-actor audit is a repudiation weakness enabling persistent tampering. It has no direct target-report consequence, so it is an enabler with no Damage score.
ratings.issue: Repudiation weakness; enabler, not distinct target-report threat.

ratings.rationale: Management-network intrusion is an entry enabler for controlling L4 assets. Viasat and CISA advisory give strong analogue satellite-network evidence; Olchawa 2025 is not assessed.

rubric_ambiguities: Enabler D null conflicts with goals list; I used goals [] for enablers.
Di_strong/Di_weak are unclear for L4 threats downstream of L3 checks; I mapped to L3/L4 detection.
Evidence from another satellite network counted as analogue; general space surveys were uncertain.
Umbrella duplicate T4.12 spans several records; one related_id is insufficient.
Denial of a whole constellation has no explicit Damage class; I capped denial at 3.
batch_comments.overall: This L4 batch contains many enablers and a broad duplicate. Evidence is often analogue or non-malicious path evidence. Downstream T4.08/T4.10 are high-risk because they bypass L3 checks. Missing L1-L3 timing, RF and report-integrity threats are more important than several generic governance records.
